palette_rule: docs/GM-SUBJECT-WORLDS.md §0: a plate carries paper, ink, cream/lamp-soft, one lamp token and at most one subject accent (accent or field). ochre, coral and plum are state hues and are forbidden in art, so no prompt asks for them any more; round 1's parent prompt asked for 'muted plum #6a3e74' and shipped 7.08 % of the frame in the plum hue band (review round 1, defect 1).

rows.prompt: Square textless painted cover plate for a Japanese language course set in a lantern district cafe. Opaque gouache illustration on warm off-white paper #f7f1e4, flat brush-shaped marks visible inside each mass, no gradient, no glow, no photographic texture. One dark warm-brown ink contour #3a2318 drawn last over the paint, even weight, never black, never grey. One soft key light from the upper left: each mass carries a single shade plane down-right in a slightly deeper tint of the same pigment and one narrow cream #efe0c2 highlight on its top-left edge. Palette strictly limited to paper #f7f1e4, warm brown line #3a2318, cream #efe0c2 and lamp gold #e8a93a. No other colour at all: no orange, no rust, no red, no pink, no purple, no plum, no mauve, no sage, no green, no blue, no ochre brown. COMPOSITION, mandatory: a square plate whose painted scene fills the full height of the canvas, with every subject inside the central 76 percent of the width and clean bare paper margins down both the left and right edges. Inside the scene: one large paper lantern with an ink cap and a single horizontal rib hanging at the upper left; a noren doorway panel with three vertical slits hanging at the upper right; a cafe counter edge with two round stools across the lower third; on the counter one cup with two curling steam lines. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no Japanese characters, no kana, no kanji, no signage, no menu board, no labels, no logo, no watermark, no signature, no UI, no border, no frame, no drop shadow, no gradient, no glow, no glass reflection, no torii gate, no temple, no geisha, no people.
